description: The autonomy.changes happy path (S56 T6): the append-only audit rows in the store's order (oldest first), filtered by root and/or grant. The Summary is a fixed template from ids and enums — never the note or the reason (SEC-033: a summary that echoed free text would let an operator smuggle a message into an audit trail that downstream tools parse). An absent limit means every row; the rows are the source of truth, and autonomy.show answers the same rows for one grant.
